title: Reduce Reuse Recycle - Hillcrest JVLR
summary: On 4th November 2026, residents of AB and C Wings of Hillcrest Society enthusiastically participated in a pre-loved items collection drive organised by RCMSEP.
description:
On 4th November 2026, residents of AB and C Wings of Hillcrest Society enthusiastically participated in a pre-loved items collection drive organised by RCMSEP. The evening collection drive was coordinated by Project Lead Rtn. Simran Jagtiani, with support from Sukumar Uncle, Treasurer of the C Wing Committee, who generously offered his residence as a collection point.

The drive received an overwhelming response, with 41 bags of pre-loved items, including a large teddy bear, collected from generous residents. The society committee also facilitated transportation of the collected items.

The collection was handed over to Girija Welfare Association and is expected to benefit 70+ residents of old-age homes and children's homes in Navi Mumbai and Dombivli, helping improve their quality of life.
